criticalIlFinding.downstreamUse: Form2_Load reads Form1.TextBox15 and converts it to a number while constructing the output form
criticalIlFinding.interpretation: The software injects its own local pseudorandom value every time a roulette result button is entered. Therefore its recommendations are not a deterministic extraction of information from the casino RNG history; at least one recommendation input is independent local randomness. This cannot create information about a certified independent casino RNG.

claims: managed to beat a random number generators RNG system used by casinos
vendorAlsoStates: RNG outcomes do not produce predictable patterns or repeating sequences

secondaryDescription.claim: Axa 5.0 is described as an analyser for online roulette variants whose algorithm picks numbers to play over three spins based on entered history.

practiceFalsification.proxyBasis: Repeated-number UI plus vendor three-spin set claim; explicitly not claimed to be exact reverse-engineered AXA logic.
practiceFalsification.interpretation: A past-results repeated-number/three-spin proxy converges to ordinary European roulette house edge under a fair independent RNG.

scientificConclusion.nextUsefulResearch: If an exact live physical wheel is the target, collect wheel/dealer-specific outcomes and timing data and test prospective physical bias separately; do not use AXA RNG claims as evidence.
